label: Plugin
depicts: Angled connector block with one cable shape entering from the lower left and one plug head facing right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a more dynamic connector piece with an obvious cable feed and angled head.
avoid_when: Do not use for the centered plugin block when the shape should stay symmetrical with two top prongs.

label: Presentation
depicts: Presentation screen on one stand showing four vertical bars growing from left to right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a presentation screen that clearly shows vertical bar columns on the slide.
avoid_when: Do not use for the presentation with a diagonal chart path when the slide should read as bars instead of a trend line.

label: Presentation
depicts: Presentation screen on one stand showing one rising diagonal chart path across the slide
use_when: Use when the interface wants a presentation screen focused on a rising trend or line chart path.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bar chart presentation when the slide should be read as separate vertical columns.

label: Presentation
depicts: Blank hanging presentation screen above one tripod style stand with no chart marks inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a plain presentation screen shape without any chart content inside it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the chart screens when the slide should contain bars or a rising chart path.

label: Qrcode
depicts: Square QR code with three large finder boxes at the top left top right and bottom left corners
use_when: Use when the interface wants a classic QR code pattern with the usual three large corner finder boxes.
avoid_when: Do not use for the stylized QR code when the corner blocks should look more open and simplified.
